sql:
explain (costs off)
select p from
  (values (box(point(0,0), point(0.5,0.5))),
          (box(point(0.5,0.5), point(0.75,0.75))),
          (box(point(0.8,0.8), point(1.0,1.0)))) as v(bb)
cross join lateral
  (select p from gist_tbl where p <@ bb order by p <-> bb[0] limit 2) ss
